# The public records the key table cites, one line per record. Columns:
# url, published, role, lists. published is the UTC time the record was
# published, read from the record itself: a bug's creation_time, a comment's
# creation_time, a post's datePublished, a OneCRL record's last_modified.
# role is status when the record reports the key's status (a compromised
# key or a removed root), and lists when it only lists the key. lists names
# the keys the record lists: certs:<capture file> for every row with a
# certificate in that file, pkh:<pubKeyHash> for the row whose SPKI digest
# it is, root:<subject common name> for the root row of that name.
# A row's source is the sorted urls of the records that list it; its
# reported is the UTC date of the earliest of those whose role is status.
# The root's two records name it by subject alone: no record captured on
# 2026-10-26 lists its certificate SHA-256, so its binding to the committed
# certificate is by name until a root-store record that lists it is captured.
